summary.name: Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM)
summary.one_liner: An AI research and note-taking assistant from Google that answers questions and generates summaries, mind maps, audio overviews and video overviews from your own source material.
use_cases: creating audio overviews of study material
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI research and thinking partner that is grounded in the information users provide, built with the latest Gemini models. It can turn brainstorms into mind maps, assignments into audio overviews, and textbooks into video overviews. It is positioned for quick summarization and note taking. The page itself gives few technical details beyond these descriptions.
notable: Generates audio overviews and video overviews from source material
Built on the latest Gemini models
Answers are grounded in user-provided information
caveats: The page gives no detailed pricing or limits; the 'free' label comes from the collection listing, not the page itself
